title: Curriculum Hub
description: Canonical schema of a candidate's resume hub. Structured source of truth for AI analysis and tailored resume generation. All keys and enum values are English (snake_case); the schema is the canonical structure for every locale.

personal_info.description: Candidate's personal data. At least the name is required.

summary.description: Executive summary of the candidate in the default language (always a string). For per-locale summaries use summary_i18n.

summary_i18n.description: Summary per locale: { pt: '...', en: '...', es: '...' } — keys must be one of pt, en, es.

experience.description: Professional history in reverse chronological order (most recent first).

achievements.description: Measurable achievements with impact (e.g. metrics, % of improvement).

skills.description: Skills with proficiency level. Default level 'intermediate'. Prefer recording 'since' (year of first use) and computing years of experience dynamically up to today — a fixed years_of_experience value becomes stale over time.

since.description: Year of first use of the skill (e.g. 2018). Preferred over a fixed years_of_experience.

years_of_experience.description: Optional when 'since' is present — it is recommended to compute it dynamically (current year - since).

projects.description: Personal, open-source, portfolio or relevant work projects.

preferences.description: Candidate's job-application preferences. Optional — hubs without it remain valid. Used by cv-tailor and cv-cover-letter as the application gate.

dislikes.description: Things the candidate doesn't like or that don't fit them in a job offer (e.g. on-site roles, legacy stacks, on-call rotations, micromanagement).

excluded_roles.description: Roles or functions the candidate doesn't want to assume (e.g. people management, sales, support).

min_match_percentage.description: Minimum weighted match percentage (gap analysis) for the candidate to apply. Below this threshold cv-tailor/cv-cover-letter recommend NOT applying and produce a feedback report instead of the artifact. Default 70 when absent.

profile_objective.description: Candidate's current profile objective — what the profile is positioning for (looking for a job, building connections, selling services, or personal branding). Optional — hubs without it remain valid (backward compatible, no migration required). Recorded ONLY when the user declares it (asked in the cv-hub build/update flow); never inferred. Drives positioning (headline, About, quick descriptions, skill recommendations) in the career-sector reports (cv-optimize/cv-linkedin).

type.description: Closed-enum profile objective: job_search (looking for a job), connections (building a network), services_sales (selling services) or personal_branding (building a personal brand).

target_role.description: Optional free string with the literal target role(s)/service(s), e.g. 'Tech Leader', 'Tech Lead PHP/Laravel'.

note.description: Optional free string with context, e.g. 'unemployed, immediate availability, remote'.

sources.description: List of source files used to build the hub.
